title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - AgreementSpecification
description: A template of an agreement that can be used when establishing partnerships (TM Forum TMF651 Agreement Management 4.0.0, Swagger definition AgreementSpecification; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:AgreementSpecification:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'AgreementSpecification'

Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:AgreementSpecification:<tmfId>. Unique identifier of the agreement specification

href.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF651_AgreementManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF651-Agreement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AgreementSpecification/properties/href'. Reference of the agreement specification

description.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF651_AgreementManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF651-Agreement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AgreementSpecification/properties/description'. A narrative that explains in detail what the agreement specification is about

isBundle.description: Property. name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF651_AgreementManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF651-Agreement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AgreementSpecification/properties/name'. Name of the agreement specification

attachment.description: Property. relatedParty.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF651_AgreementManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF651-Agreement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AgreementSpecification/properties/relatedParty'. Related Entity reference. A related party defines party or party role linked to a specific entity.

serviceCategory.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF651_AgreementManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF651-Agreement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AgreementSpecification/properties/serviceCategory'. The category for grouping recommendations. In TMF this is a CategoryRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced Category entity (urn:ngsi-ld:Category:<tmf id>).
